reason: A Settings UI for viewing archived sessions and performing unarchive or destructive deletion operations; human review is appropriate because installation can patch host core behavior and run a downloaded shell script.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 设置中查看归档会话，并支持取消归档、删除选中项或删除全部归档会话。
summaries.en: Manage archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness Settings by viewing, unarchiving, deleting selected sessions, or deleting all archived sessions.

capabilities: Lists archived sessions and displays workspace, directory, title, and update metadata
Unarchives individual or selected archived sessions through host RPCs
Deletes individual, selected, or all archived sessions with confirmations
Provides a desktop installation script that downloads and installs the plugin, modifies an embedded allowlist, and restarts the app
Provides a patch that adds host-side session unarchive and deletion APIs
